name: Ro 04-6790
summary: Ro 04-6790 is a drug, developed by Hoffmann–La Roche, which has applications in scientific research. It acts as a potent and selective receptor antagonist for the 5-HT6 serotonin receptor subtype, with little or no affinity at other receptors.

pharmacology.text: It acts as a potent and selective receptor antagonist for the 5-HT6 serotonin receptor subtype, with little or no affinity at other receptors.

uses.text: Ro 04-6790 is a drug, developed by Hoffmann–La Roche, which has applications in scientific research.

fact.en: Ro 04-6790 was one of the first tools made to block the serotonin 5-HT6 receptor, which was discovered only in the 1990s and is found almost entirely in the brain.
fact.zh: Ro 04-6790 是最早用來阻斷血清素 5-HT6 受體的研究工具之一，這個受體直到 1990 年代才被發現，而且幾乎只存在於大腦中。
fact.zhHans: Ro 04-6790 是最早用来阻断血清素 5-HT6 受体的研究工具之一，这个受体直到 1990 年代才被发现，而且几乎只存在于大脑中。
